parser_metadata.parser: semicolon Date/Time + seven numeric channels, then complete-hour observed means
parser_metadata.timestamp_grid: complete one-minute grid required before hourly aggregation
parser_metadata.availability_label: each hourly row is labelled by end-of-hour timestamp
parser_metadata.hour_observed_rule: channel observed iff at least one minute in the hour is observed; otherwise mask False and value NaN
parser_metadata.estimated_rows_before_raw: official 2,075,259 minute rows imply about 34,587 complete hours before boundary/quality checks

eval.selection: stride 48 from all legal origins, every channel has at least one observed future target cell

origin_observability_filter.rule: all FIT/TUNE/EVAL origins require every channel to have at least one observed future target cell in the H48 window; availability-only, no value/effect filter

pca_initialization.note: PCA initializes E/D only; trainable E/D means this is not a fixed-compression claim.

uci235_household_hourly.history_contract: causal forward fill is reset to FIT mean at each L512 window start
uci235_household_hourly.target_contract: future target is not forward filled; missing cells are NaN in physical payload and 0 with bool mask in normalized payload
uci235_household_hourly.eval_separation: FIT_TUNE, EVAL past input, and EVAL future target are separate payloads
